recognize_zh: 這顆大細胞核大而圓、染色質較細並可見數個核仁，細胞質呈深藍色（強嗜鹼性）且靠近核處有淡染區，外觀像免疫母細胞（immunoblast-like）的反應性淋巴球，需與原始細胞區分。
features: Large cell, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with round nucleus
Relatively fine to reticulated chromatin with two or more visible nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone on one side
Smooth round cell outline; no granules, vacuoles or Auer rods
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, high N:C ratio, reticulated chromatin and several visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic with a paler perinuclear zone and contains no granules or Auer rods. In isolation this cell resembles a blast; however, in the context of a heterogeneous lymphocytosis with a spectrum of reactive forms, it is consistent with an immunoblast-like reactive lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have very fine homogeneous chromatin, less intensely basophilic cytoplasm, may show Auer rods or granules, and are MPO positive, whereas immunoblasts show deep blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone amid other reactive lymphocytes.
Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant, less basophilic cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli, and are TdT/CD34 positive.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with a distinct Golgi hof and express CD138/MUM1 rather than being part of a mixed reactive population.

ddx.dx: Large cell lymphoma in blood (e.g. Burkitt or DLBCL)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells form a monotonous population, and Burkitt cells show deep blue cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles, unlike isolated reactive immunoblasts.
